subject: Request: Incident response plan, recent IR evidence, and redacted artifacts
messages:
From: Aaron Martin <aaron.martin@pinebrook.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@pinebrook.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for incident response plan & recent IR evidence

Hi Lauren,

We received a notification via our monitoring vendors about a transient authentication anomaly on 2026-09-12 that impacted token exchange calls touching Redwood-hosted endpoints. Pinebrook's security and compliance teams are preparing for an internal audit and need the following: a copy of your current Incident Response Plan, a short chronology of the 9/12 event as known to Redwood, and an extract of relevant audit logs (authentication/token issuance) covering 2026-09-11 through 9/13.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide a redacted forensic summary and a small sample of audit logs for our SOC 2 evidence package? We need items to be delivered under NDA controls by EOD Friday, 9/17. Also please indicate if you anticipate any IP or customer-identifying data in the artifacts we should plan to redact.

Thanks,
Aaron Martin
Director, Information Security
Pinebrook Finance
aaron.martin@pinebrook.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

--
This request is time-sensitive for our compliance window; feel free to +1 me if you want to triage faster.

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Martin <aaron.martin@pinebrook.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for incident response plan & recent IR evidence

Hi Aaron,

Thanks for the heads up and the clear list. We're on it. High level: we ran an investigation on 9/12 and found a short-lived auth routing race that temporarily increased 5xxs for token exchange calls between 14:12-14:38 UTC; no customer data was exposed and all persistent stores were unaffected. We'll prepare a redacted forensic summary plus a narrow log extract that satisfies SOC 2 needs.

Next steps from our side:
- Marissa will assemble a redacted IR summary and a cover letter for your audit team.
- Karthik will extract a tightly-scoped log slice (auth subsystem only) and remove any full PII/identifiers.
- Ben will review the artifacts for SIG/CAIQ mapping notes.

Can you confirm the exact redaction requirements (tokens vs email vs account ids) and whether Pinebrook prefers JSONL logs or CSV samples? We'll aim to deliver the initial packet by 2026-09-17 18:00 PDT.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0220

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aaron Martin <aaron.martin@pinebrook.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request for incident response plan & recent IR evidence

Hi team / Aaron,

Attaching the preliminary items for your review. Attached: redwood_irp_v2.pdf (internal IRP with public-facing sections only), forensic_summary_pinebrook_redacted.pdf (narrative + timeline), and audit_log_excerpt_20260912.jsonl (sampleed auth log lines with account ids hashed).

Notes:
- We hashed account identifiers with salted SHA256; we removed bearer tokens and any full email addresses.
- The log extract contains only the token exchange path (auth service) and is limited to 2026-09-12 14:00-15:00 UTC.
- The forensic summary includes our detection, triage timeline, mitigations applied, and the post-incident follow-up actions.

Aaron, please let us know if you need additional redaction or a different file format. We can produce CSV samples if your tooling prefers that.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_irp_v2.pdf (application/pdf), forensic_summary_pinebrook_redacted.pdf (application/pdf), audit_log_excerpt_20260912.jsonl (application/jsonl)

From: Aaron Martin <aaron.martin@pinebrook.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@pinebrook.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for incident response plan & recent IR evidence

Marissa / Lauren,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments — received. A couple of clarifications from our side:
1) The audit team requests that account ids be pseudonymized (which your salted SHA256 satisfies) but we'd prefer a separate mapping file that uses ephemeral internal ids so we can reconcile events without seeing original account values. Can you produce a mapping file with ephemeral id -> hashed id? It must also be delivered under the NDA.
2) For the IRP, do you have a short one-page cover note that states the version, contact point for follow-up, and whether the IRP is the canonical internal plan? That helps our auditors catalog the artifact.

If you can provide those two items by EOD Thursday (9/16) we'll be able to slot these into Pinebrook's audit binder.

Regards,
Aaron

--
Aaron Martin
Director, Information Security
Pinebrook Finance

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Martin <aaron.martin@pinebrook.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for incident response plan & recent IR evidence

Aaron,

Appreciate the specific asks. Attached: a one-page cover note (linked in Drive) confirming redwood_irp_v2.pdf is the current canonical IRP for production services, and a small mapping file mapping ephemeral IDs to hashed ids (delivered under NDA). Karthik attached a short checksum file and confirmed the log extract integrity; Ben added a line item noting where the artifacts map to SIG/CAIQ controls for your auditors.

Action items completed:
- One-page cover note uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/IRP-v2 (Drive doc: IRP cover - Pinebrook)
- Mapping file delivered under NDA (mapping_ephemeral_to_hashed_ids.csv)
- Audit log sample format: JSONL; we can convert to CSV on request.

If you or your audit team need anything else (longer retention exports, egress samples, or attestations), reply to this thread and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachment note: final artifacts transferred to Pinebrook's secure drop; contact marissa_cole@redwood.com for the NDA key and mapping file retrieval instructions.
